definitions: Ornamental or decorative material used to finish a garment or item.
The state or condition of a ship or aircraft with respect to its balance and stability.
A haircut, especially one that tidies the ends of the hair.
The act of cutting or pruning something to make it neat or tidy.
examples: The dress had a lace trim.
The captain checked the trim of the vessel.
I need a trim; my hair is getting long.
The gardener gave the hedges a good trim.
